node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1:conseque: The Quarantine of Stratholme — The Roads Beyond

node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1: The Quarantine of the Afflicted City
node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1:conseque: The Quarantine of the Afflicted City — The Roads Beyond

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1.title: The Quarantine of the Afflicted City
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1.text: If the plague expedition chooses quarantine, the afflicted city is to be contained rather than condemned to an immediate purge. The commander commits to saving the kingdom by holding the infection within its walls.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1:conseque.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:1:conseque.text: A cordon would bind the city’s fate to its guards, its stores and the discipline of those confined within. The Crown would have to sustain a siege against its own afflicted people while keeping soldiers ready for the undead beyond.

points.title: The Quarantine of the Afflicted City

node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2:conseque: The Evacuation of Stratholme — The Roads Beyond

node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2: The Evacuation of the Afflicted City
node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2:conseque: The Evacuation of the Afflicted City — The Roads Beyond

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2.title: The Evacuation of the Afflicted City
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2.text: If the expedition chooses evacuation, the threatened people become its charge. The flight also sets the western refuge movement in motion, turning the defence of a city toward the preservation of its survivors.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2:conseque.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.30:2:conseque.text: The kingdom would exchange the defence of a threatened city for the protection of a moving people. Soldiers, families and skilled hands carried away from the plague could become the strength of a distant refuge, leaving fewer hands to defend the lands they had abandoned.

points.title: The Evacuation of the Afflicted City

node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:0:conseque: A Companion Remains for the Purge — The Roads Beyond

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:0.title: A Companion Remains for the Purge
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:0.text: If the expedition’s chosen companion stands beside the commander during the purge, that companion shares the decision from which they might otherwise have withdrawn. Their presence changes the company that remains united at the afflicted city.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:0:conseque.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:0:conseque.text: The companion’s continued presence could preserve an important voice within the company while binding their reputation to the slaughter. The breach between the commander and those who condemned the purge would acquire a different shape, with that companion among its participants rather than its departing witnesses.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:3-4.title: A Companion Leaves the Plague Expedition
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:3-4.text: A companion may leave the plague expedition rather than share its chosen course. If the departing character is the companion chosen to lead a western refuge, that departure may carry the Prophet’s call onward.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:3-4:conseq.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.35:3-4:conseq.text: The commander would lose the counsel and assistance of the departing companion. A withdrawal need not end every personal bond, and its meaning depends on whether the company had chosen slaughter, containment or flight.

node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:0:conseque: Jaina Sails North — The Roads Beyond
A Companion Sails North — The Roads Beyond

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:0.title: A Companion Sails North
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:0.text: If the expedition’s chosen companion follows the commander to Northrend, that companion remains with the pursuit across the sea. Another human ruler may instead be sought to carry the western refuge movement.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:0:conseque.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:0:conseque.text: The northern expedition would retain that companion’s counsel and assistance, while the western refugees might gather beneath another banner. The histories of the northern pursuit and the western refuge would consequently turn upon different leaders.

node_headings.goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:1:conseque: The Pursuit Refused — The Roads Beyond
The Pursuit Refused — The Roads Beyond

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:1.title: The Pursuit Refused
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:1.text: A companion who refuses the voyage north leaves the expedition’s pursuit behind. The defeat of the undead at the expedition’s afflicted city is judged sufficient cause to part from the commander’s vengeance.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:1:conseque.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.45:1:conseque.text: The northern company would be diminished by that departure.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.87:0.title: The King Survives
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.87:0.text: If the throne-room defence prevails, the king survives the attempted betrayal. The returning commander and the other attending conspirators are executed, and the commander’s holding is brought under royal authority.

goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.87:0:conseque.title: The Roads Beyond
goa:branch:wc_arthas_story.87:0:conseque.text: The realm would retain a living sovereign around whom surviving nobles and soldiers could rally. With the traitorous commander dead, the Scourge would need other servants to carry out its work, and resistance could continue beneath the realm’s own royal authority.
